image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large iguana resting in grassy vegetation. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. The iguana has textured, greyish-green scales, a prominent dewlap under the chin, and a row of spines running down its back. The background is blurred green foliage.
